errors.evidence: The gray lines represent the individual data for each year from 2011 to 2019, forming a range or band, not an average.
For the 2011-2019 period, the lowest point reached by any line is approximately 15%, and this occurs in April/May, not March. The value in March is higher.

errors.text_span: um sich bis Juli auf etwa 80 % zu erhöhen
errors.evidence: In July, the band of gray lines for 2011-2019 is very wide, spanning approximately 30% to 90%. Describing this as increasing to 'about 80%' is an over-generalization.

The legend indicates that the year 2020 is represented by a pink line ('2020' is next to a pink line segment). The description incorrectly associates it with a purple ('lila') line, which actually corresponds to the year 2021.

errors.text_span: beginnt im Januar bei etwa 90 %, fällt im März auf etwa 70 %
errors.evidence: The line for 2020 (pink) starts at approximately 97%, not 90%. It reaches its lowest point of about 72% in May, not March. In March, its value is around 80%.
The line for 2021 (purple) reaches its minimum value of about 25% in May, not March. In March, the value is approximately 40%.
The line for 2022 (green) reaches its minimum value of about 25% in April, not March. In March, the value is approximately 30%, not 10%.
The line for 2023 (light blue) reaches its minimum value of approximately 65% in May, not March. In March, the value is about 72%, not 30%.
The line for 2024 (dark blue) reaches its minimum value of approximately 62% in mid-April, not March. In March, the value is about 70%.
The line for 2024 ends in December at approximately 80%, not 90%.

errors.text_span: Die hellblaue Linie für 2025 beginnt im Januar bei etwa 90 %, fällt im März auf etwa 30 % und steigt bis Dezember auf etwa 90 %.
errors.evidence: The description for the 2025 line is entirely wrong. The chart shows the 2025 line only from January to early March, starting around 78% and falling to about 37%. The description hallucinates its starting value, its value in March, and its behavior for the rest of the year.

errors.text_span: die erste Markierung im März bei etwa 30 %
errors.evidence: The first blue square marker for the storage obligation ('Speicherverpflichtung') is in February, not March.

The description omits one of the three square markers for the 'Speicherverpflichtung'. It mentions markers in March (incorrectly placed, should be Feb) and October, but misses the third marker in November at approximately 90%.

errors.text_span: Ein blauer Punkt im November zeigt den aktuellen Speicherstand in Deutschland bei ca. 37 %.
errors.evidence: This is a misinterpretation of the chart's annotations. The text label 'Aktueller Speicherstand in Deutschland bei ca. 37 %' has an arrow pointing to the end of the 2025 line in early March, not to the blue dot. The blue dot is in November at a value of approximately 43% and is not explicitly labeled.
